_comment: Template for <live>/claude-settings.json, the settings every headless claude run of the daemon uses (triage brain, person note run, second source, backfill, probe). wa_setup.py init renders it and writes the result with mode 0600. Placeholders: {LIVE_DIR} is the absolute live folder (paths.live_dir), {WA_HOME} is the absolute kit home folder (paths.home) and {HOME} is the absolute home folder of the Mac user, all without a trailing slash. Every path rule is written as Read(/ followed by the placeholder, so after rendering it reads Read(//absolute/path): this form blocks the Read tool under claude -p with --settings. Read rules also cover Grep and Glob. The tool names in permissions.deny must stay identical to DENY_TOOLS in daemon/wa_live.py (the daemon merges both lists and logs any difference). The brain may still read WhatsApp media under Message/Media and the vault; it may not read the chat databases, the reader snapshots, the document text cache, the voice transcript cache, secrets (token files included), the vault write backups (copies of the owner's task files taken before the daemon's write button changed them) or state. Denying the transcript cache loses the brain nothing: the transcripts of the voice notes in its run already reach it inside the conversation pack, and the cache holds the transcripts of every chat, not only the one being judged. A deny rule whose path contains a space and ends in a glob also blocks, and a sibling media file stays readable; the deny probe (<live>/commands/probe-claude.json with read_canary, which tries one marker file in secrets, one in the transcript cache and one in the vault write backups, and the pitfalls page) checks this on the owner's Mac. Keep this key free of other placeholders: the renderer refuses unknown ones.
